chapter_title: Concerning why Some shall delay to come forth from the Body, and Others die in an instant.
chapter_note: Extremely fragmentary kephalaion dominated by dialogue frame/questions. Only ¶2 preserves a non-framing, enumerative explanation ("The second...") that likely belonged to the older systematic teaching about differentiated death/departure timings, but the cosmological mechanism is lost in lacunae; classification remains tentative.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic/dialogue frame: disciples address "the apostle" and "our master" with a beseeching question formula; this is compilation frame language rather than impersonal teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The [sec]ond [ ... ] if he shall fall [ ... ... ] one [ ... ... ] one hour [ ... ... ] others who shall [ ... ... ] and they remain. They shall delay until they [ ... ... ] he is freed, and they delay to come toward [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Non-framing, impersonal enumerative structure ("The second...") consistent with an underlying systematic explanation distinguishing cases (immediate vs delayed release). Very lacunose; lack of explicit cosmological vocabulary may be due to damage rather than late composition.
Repetition of beseeching address to "our master" asking for instruction; Q&A framing typical of the Kephalaia editorial container.
Dialogue attribution formula ("Then he says...") without preserved teaching content; such attributions are part of the later compilation frame.
